finding.name: SAME_INVOCATION_JSPACE_CONTROL_TEMPORAL_CIRCULARITY
finding.observed_order: model invocation(i) -> ModelExecutionObservation(i) -> model contribution/output(i) -> JSpaceStep(i) -> VectorControlPacket(i)
finding.problem: VectorControlPacket(i), being produced downstream of invocation(i), cannot be credited as the packet that controlled the exact input bytes of invocation(i). Exact hashes and a byte-occurrence binding can remain internally consistent while the claimed same-step control direction is temporally impossible.
finding.counterhypothesis: The current byte-binding primitive could be correct in isolation but be integrated post hoc onto the same invocation whose output helped produce the packet, yielding association rather than forward control.
finding.required_topology: JSpaceStep(t)/VectorControlPacket(t) -> ModelInputControlBinding(t->t+1) -> ModelExecutionObservation(t+1) -> VerifiedModelExecution(t+1) -> InferenceReceipt(t+1) -> contribution/output(t+1) -> JSpaceStep(t+1)/VectorControlPacket(t+1)
finding.boot_rule: An initial invocation may use an explicit versioned NO_PREDECESSOR_CONTROL/null-control condition; it must never be backfilled with a packet produced after the invocation.

durable_delta.promotion_rule: HCU_MODEL_INPUT_CONTROL_BINDING/v1 may establish exact packet presence in exact executor input bytes at component scope, but positive forward-control credit additionally requires an admitted acyclic predecessor J-Space identity. Same-invocation post-hoc binding receives zero control-direction credit.
durable_delta.next_deterministic_regression: Use two adjacent logical steps: produce packet(t) from completed JSpaceStep(t), embed it exactly once in immutable executor input for invocation(t+1), bind/admit before or at execution admission, and reject any edge rebinding packet(t+1) generated from output(t+1) onto invocation(t+1).
